{{Quote|You'd ''better'' watch your step, 'cause&hellip; ''everyone'' knows it ''isn't'' wise to ''upset'' a ''Wookiee sheriff''!|[[Jenna (Corellian)|Jenna]], to [[Bo-Dum]]|<ref name="TCK" />}}
'''Sheriff''' was a [[police rank]] for a chief [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] of a certain area, usually a [[City/Legends|city]].

==History==
[[Encot]] served as the sheriff of [[Anchorhead/Legends|Anchorhead]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and was in charge of the [[Citizens' Militia]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Smuggler's Route|Tatooine}}</ref>

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] settlers of a [[Unidentified planet (Jenna)|certain planet]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] were protected by a [[Jenna's father|sheriff]]. When he was [[Death/Legends|killed]], the settlers found nobody to replace him, although [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] briefly assumed that role. In that Corellian community, the sheriff [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] a wide-brimmed hat and a poncho adorned with a star-shaped badge. The sheriff was tasked with protecting the community as well as managing the [[Prison/Legends|jailhouse]].<ref name="TCK" />
